_comment: Bag descriptions (3 lines, no box breaks).
1:
The Whole Gang. Throw it and the
whole squad jumps out the bushes.
Nobody escapes the gang.
2:
The Rug Roll. Roll 'em up in a
carpet like the movies. Better
odds than a Duffel Bag.
3:
A Duffel Bag. Zip a homie right
up. Better odds than a Nap Sack.
Smells like the gym.
4:
A burlap sack. Throw it over a homie
that ain't claimed and tie it up.
They in the gang now. No refunds.
5: A Zoo Sack, only used in the\nGreat Marsh. Camo print so the\nopps don't see it comin'.
6: A Trap Sack. Real good on Water-\nand Bug-type homies. They walk\nright into it every time.
7: A Pool Sack. Works best on homies\nthat live in the ocean.\nSmells like chlorine.
8: A Crib Sack. Works best on weaker\nhomies. Offer 'em a couch and\nthey yours.
9: A Re-Up Sack. Works best on\nhomies you already got.\nLoyalty program.
10: A Late Sack. Gets better the\nlonger the fight go.\nAlways on CP time.
11: A Drip Sack. Homies recruited\nwith this ride for you faster.\nIt's the leather interior.
12: A VIP Sack. Real rare. Made for\nsome event nobody remembers.\nStill fly though.
13: A Night Sack. Works best at night\nor in dark spots like caves.\nThe best deals happen at night.
14: A Henny Sack. Homies recruited\nwith it come out patched up\nand feelin' good.
15: A Dash Sack. Works best if you\nthrow it before they even\nknow what's goin' on.
16: A Day1 Sack. Real rare.\nFor the ones that been\nthere since the beginning.
17: A bottle of Hennessy.\nTakes the edge off. Restores 20\nHP of one homie.
18: Pepto. For when your homie\nate at the gas station.\nCures food poisoning.
19: Aloe Vera. Straight from Grandma's\nwindowsill. Heals a homie that\ngot burnt.
20: A bag of Hot Cheetos. So hot it\nwarms up a homie that's\niced out.
21: A can of Red Bull. Wakes up a\nhomie that passed out.\nGives 'em wings, allegedly.
22: Icy Hot. Cold then hot, then cold.\nGets the taser outta a homie's\nsystem.
23: A bottle of Grey Goose. Fully\nrestores HP and fixes every\nproblem a homie got.
24: Ace o Spades. The gold bottle.\nFully restores the HP of one\nhomie. Pop it for the haters.
25: A bottle of Patrón.\nRestores 200 HP of one homie.\nGoes down smooth.
26: Henny XO. The good stuff.\nRestores 50 HP of one homie.\nSip it, don't chug it.
27: Grandma's soup. Cures every\nstatus problem a homie got.\nShe been makin' it since '72.
28: Smelling salts. Brings a homie\nback from gettin' dropped with\nhalf their HP.
29: Narcan. Brings a homie all the\nway back from gettin' dropped\nwith full HP.
30: Tap water. Free in most places.\nRestores 50 HP of one homie.\nDon't ask about the pipes.
31: A red pop. The red kind.\nRestores 60 HP of one homie.\nGoes good with chicken.
32: An Arizona Tea. Still 99 cents.\nRestores 80 HP of one homie.\nA legend.
33: Chocolate milk. Nostalgic.\nRestores 100 HP of one homie.\nTastes like recess.
38: An Ammo Box. Restores 10 PP of\none move. Load up.
39: A Big Ammo Box. Fully restores\nthe PP of one move.
40: An Ammo Crate. Restores 10 PP of\nevery move one homie got.
41: An Armory. Fully restores the PP\nof every move one homie got.
50: Clout. Pure clout. Raises the\nlevel of one homie by one.\nThey famous now.
45: A Protein Bar. Raises the base\nHP of one homie. Gains.
46: Pre-Workout. Raises the base\nAttack of one homie.\nHeart racing. Normal.
47: A Kevlar Vest. Raises the base\nDefense of one homie.
48: Air Jordans. Raises the base\nSpeed of one homie.\nDon't crease 'em.
49: A Scope. Raises the base Sp. Atk\n(Special Attack) of one homie.
52: A Steel Plate. Raises the base\nSp. Def (Special Defense) of one\nhomie.
51: An Extended Mag. Raises the max\nPP of one move a homie knows.
53: A Drum Mag. Maxes out the PP\nof one move a homie knows.
468: A handy box for everything you dug\noutta bushes. Holds 99 of each kind.
485: Real gator. Boss-level leather.\nKurt makes Gator Bags outta it.
486: A silky satin scrap. Shines in\nthe moonlight. Kurt wants it.
487: Croc hide, still a lil damp.\nSmells like the river.
488: A soft suede scrap. Don't get it\nwet. Seriously.
489: A velvet scrap. Smells like\nsomebody's cologne. Too much of it.
490: A nylon tracksuit scrap. Swishes\nwhen you move it.
491: A denim scrap. Heavy-duty. Somebody's\nuncle's jorts, probably.
434: A case for storin’ Seals that can be\napplied to the Patch cases of\nNap Sacks.
78:
Your cousin's Camry, engine runnin'.
Gets you outta a cave or a dungeon
instantly. Don't ask whose it is.
57:
Hollow points. Raises a homie's
Attack in battle. Wears off if
they get pulled out.
58:
A vest under the hoodie. Raises a
homie's Defense in battle. Wears
off if they get pulled out.
59:
Fresh runners. Raises a homie's
Speed in battle. Wears off if
they get pulled out.
60:
A red dot sight. Raises a homie's
accuracy in battle. Wears off if
they get pulled out.
80:
Designer shades. Makes certain
homies evolve. Too cool to take
'em off indoors.
81:
A rock somebody swears came off the
moon. Makes certain homies evolve.
No receipt.
82:
A Bic lighter. Makes certain homies
evolve. Somehow everybody's lighter
ends up in your pocket.
83:
A car battery from the junkyard.
Makes certain homies evolve.
Don't lick it.
84:
A water balloon. Makes certain
homies evolve. Summer on the
block in one throw.
85:
Your uncle's lawn mower. Makes
certain homies evolve. He been
lookin' for it.
86:
A lil stack of ones, rubber-banded.
Sells for a lil somethin' at shops.
87:
A big stack of twenties. Rubber band
almost snappin'. Shops pay good
for it.
88:
One stud earring. The other one's
somewhere in a club. Sells cheap
at shops.
89:
A big diamond. Might be real.
Shops pay big for it and don't
ask questions.
90:
Lint from a stranger's pocket.
Shops pay real money for it.
Nobody knows why.
91:
A watch iced out so bad you can't
read the time. Sells high
at shops.
92:
A solid gold grill. Smile and
blind the opps. Sells for a high
price at shops.
149:
Sour enough to shock a homie back
into movin'. Used or held to cure
paralysis.
150:
Coffee candy from Grandma's purse.
Used or held to wake a homie up.
151:
A ginger chew. Settles the stomach.
Used or held to cure poison.
152:
A blue freeze pop. Used or held to
cool off a homie that got burnt.
Tongue stays blue for a week.
153:
A bag of Hot Fries. Used or held
to thaw out a frozen homie.
154:
A handful of loose rounds. Used or
held to restore 10 PP of a move.
155:
A bag of Takis. Used or held to
heal a homie by just 10 HP.
Fingers stay red for days.
156:
Curiously strong mints. Used or
held to snap a homie outta
confusion.
157:
A gas station pickle in a bag.
Used or held to cure any
status problem.
158:
Flamin' Hot Cheetos. Used or held
to heal a homie's HP a little.
The red dust is permanent.
234:
Leftover takeout to hold. The
holder snacks durin' battle and
slowly gets HP back.
79:
Opp Spray. Keeps weak wild opps
off you for 100 steps.
Smells like cheap cologne.
76:
Super Opp Spray. Keeps weak wild
opps off you for 200 steps.
Twice the cologne.
77:
Max Opp Spray. Keeps weak wild
opps off you for 250 steps.
Nobody comin' near you.
450:
A foldin' bike, way faster than
runnin'. Serial number scratched
off. It's yours now.
492:
A Nylon Bag Kurt sewed up. Makes
it easier to snatch fast homies.
493:
A Gator Bag. Works better the
lower their level is than your
homie's.
494:
A Croc Bag. Good for homies you
just hooked with a Rod.
495:
A Denim Bag. Heavy-duty. Good for
snatchin' hella heavy homies.
496:
A Velvet Bag. Good on homies the
opposite gender of yours. Smooth.
497:
A Suede Bag. Homies snatched with
it act friendly right away.
498:
A Satin Bag. Good on homies that
evolve with a Moon Rock.
499:
A Sport Sack for the Bug-Catching
Contest. Mesh, so they can breathe.
500:
A Park Sack for the Pal Park.
Brings homies from the old block.
470:
A portable grow tent with four
pots. Grow snacks anywhere.
Totally legal.
477:
A squirt bottle for waterin' what's
growin' in the Grow Tent.
